business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Mainland China (PRC) as the WFOE formation jurisdiction; Taiwan as the investing jurisdiction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Chinese socialist legal system; unitary national regime; cross-strait special legal interaction; sub-national tax distinctions apply)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion (ARATS-SEF, signed 9 August 2012)
Cross-Strait Taxation Agreement for the Avoidance of Double Taxation on Income and on Tax Administrations (signed 25 August 2015)
Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) and its early-harvest arrangements (signed 29 June 2010)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (revised and adopted 8 November 2024, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Customer Due Diligence and Customer Identity Data and Transaction Records Management (People's Bank of China and SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Administrative Measures for Beneficial Ownership Information (PBOC/SAMR, effective 1 November 2024); PRC Company Law (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); PRC Foreign Investment Law and its Implementing Regulations (2020). The Taiwan investing parent remains subject to Taiwan's Money Laundering Control Act and Company Act beneficial ownership register requirements.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Commercial Registration Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarization by a district notary, followed by SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification; no Hague Apostille because Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention party; no consular legalization is applied across the Taiwan Strait; never chain any other path to this channel.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Company Registration Information of the Taiwan investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarization and SEF/ARATS verification only; the Apostille Convention path is not available for Taiwan-origin public documents, and consular legalization at a PRC embassy is not used because the cross-strait verification regime governs this document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE incorporation and appointment of legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of Taiwan investing company, notarized in Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signatures certified by a Taiwan district notary, then SEF transmits the notarized copy to ARATS for verification. This is the mutually exclusive cross-strait channel; no subsequent Hague Apostille or consular legalization step may be added.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association/Charter of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs registered corporate registry / the Taiwan company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy issued by a Taiwan notary and verified through SEF/ARATS; identical authentication treatment as above; parallel and exclusive to Hague Apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Taiwan investor's principal bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan-licensed commercial bank maintaining the investor's corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer signature notarized by a Taiwan notary and then SEF/ARATS verified; the bank's seal and signatory authority are separately notarized. The letter is not subject to Hague Apostille or consular legalization because the cross-strait verification system is the exclusive authentication path.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, supervisor, senior executive, legal representative, and beneficial owner against the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions list, UK HMT sanctions list, and Taiwan FIU watches. Matches trigger enhanced due diligence (EDD) and refusal where required by MOFCOM, PBOC or the PRC final beneficiary register. PEPs are defined to cover domestic and foreign state officials, political party officials, and senior officials from all jurisdictions including Taiwan; PEP status requires senior management approval, ongoing transaction monitoring, and source-of-funds substantiation. Sanctions-related negative media and ownership look-through of trusts and nominees are incorporated before incorporation and refreshed every 90 days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration and Management System via Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration online service, with publication on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System after registration
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be in standardized simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier pattern: administrative division + distinctive name (zihao) + industry or business characteristic + company type (limited liability company). A foreign-language or transliterated name may be used as a trade name, but the registered legal name cannot be in roman letters, pinyin only, or non-Chinese script. Transliteration of the Taiwan investor's corporate name into Chinese must be consistent, non-misleading, and avoid identical or similar names in the same trade or industry within the administrative region.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan region marks requiring special approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant first obtains the written rejection notice containing specific grounds. Then, within 15 days, file a written appeal with the original registration authority's name-review unit, attaching revised name candidates and legal arguments distinguishing the rejected mark from prior identical or similar marks. If the internal review is denied, file an administrative reconsideration with the next-higher SAMR within 60 days of the decision, or an administrative lawsuit within 6 months. The applicant may also apply for a one-time 30-day extension of an approved name reservation before its expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected as the sole registered office for the PRC WFOE. The WFOE must possess a verifiable physical premise in the registered administrative district. A commercial mailbox or virtual office may be used only as a secondary correspondence address. Municipal tax authorities and PBOC-regulated banks require a real lease contract, landlord property title certificate, property tax payment record, and on-site signage for VAT general taxpayer status, invoicing, and corporate bank account opening. For hard-enamel lapel pin manufacturing, an actual production or warehouse address is also required for export and business-license scope; failure to maintain physical substance will result in tax registration abnormality and bank account freeze risks.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: moderate, estimated at 30-40% during the first 12 months after incorporation, increasing to approximately 60% if the company applies for general VAT taxpayer status, export VAT refunds, or import/export rights. Inspection checklist: (1) company nameplate at the registered address; (2) original lease contract and landlord property ownership document; (3) actual production equipment, raw material inventory and finished enamel pins; (4) employee labor contracts and social insurance filings; (5) utility bills in the WFOE's name; (6) accounting ledgers and VAT invoices kept at the registered office; (7) a responsible representative physically available for inquiries.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Companies Act (公司法), Articles 1–10, 22–27, 128–139, 154–156, 172–176, and 202–207; Investment Commission Regulations under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; the company registration procedure is governed by the Company Act and the MOEA Organization Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Company and Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, operating through the National Corporation and Business Registration System and the Investment Commission for foreign investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (章程) together with the Application for Company Registration (公司設立登記申請書), filed with the central competent authority and accompanied by the signed list of founders, the capital verification certificate, and the directors' or shareholders' consent documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None - Taiwan Companies Act does not impose a statutory minimum paid-up capital for a general limited liability WFOE. However, the total capital stated in the Articles of Incorporation must be fully subscribed and paid-in before registration. The paid-in capital must be deposited into a segregated capital verification bank escrow account at a Taiwanese bank, and a certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report confirming that the funds are not withdrawn prior to completion of registration unless for permitted early expenditures. Foreign investment approval may impose additional minimum capital conditions for manufacturing activities at the discretion of the Investment Commission.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WE, THE UNDERSIGNED DIRECTORS AND INITIAL BOARD OF THE COMPANY, HAVE MET THIS DAY IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE LAW AND HAVE ADOPTED THE FOLLOWING RESOLUTIONS: FIRST, THAT THE COMPANY CONFIRMS ITS INCORPORATION AND ITS NAME, REGISTERED OFFICE, OBJECTS, AND ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION AS PREVIOUSLY EXECUTED BY ITS SUBSCRIBERS, AND THAT THE REGISTERED OFFICE OF THE COMPANY SHALL BE ESTABLISHED AT THE ADDRESS DESIGNATED IN THE ARTICLES, WHICH OFFICE SHALL BE THE LEGAL Domicile FOR ALL OFFICIAL NOTICES, SERVICE OF PROCESS, AND THE MAINTENANCE OF THE STATUTORY BOOKS AND RECORDS. SECOND, THAT THE BOARD HEREBY APPROVES AND ACCEPTS THE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENTS FOR THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL AND THE FULL PAID-UP CONTRIBUTIONS MADE BY EACH FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER, WHICH ARE VERIFIED BY A CERTIFIED PUBLIC ACCOUNTANT'S CAPITAL VERIFICATION REPORT; THE BOARD DIRECTS THE COMPANY TO FILE THIS REPORT WITH THE COMPETENT REGISTRY AND TO ISSUE SHARE CERTIFICATES TO EACH SHAREHOLDER REFLECTING THE EXACT AMOUNTS SO PAID FORTHWITH. THIRD, THAT THE BOARD HEREBY RESOLVES TO AUTHORIZE THE OPENING OF ONE OR MORE BANK ACCOUNTS IN THE COMPANY'S NAME AT REPUTABLE BANKS IN TAIPEI AND TO APPOINT THE MANAGING DIRECTOR AND THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER, JOINTLY ACTING WITH THE PRESIDENT AND ONE OTHER SIGNATORY DESIGNATED BY THE BOARD, AS THE BANK AUTHORIZED SIGNATORIES WITH POWER TO DRAW, ACCEPT, ENDORSE, AND EXECUTE ALL CHECKS, DRAFTS, REMITTANCES, AND INSTRUMENTS, AND TO ISSUE MANDATES AND INSTRUCTIONS FOR FUND TRANSFERS IN THE ORDINARY COURSE OF BUSINESS. FOURTH, THAT THE BOARD HEREBY ELICITS AND APPOINTS THE GENERAL MANAGER AS THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND THE CORPORATE SECRETARY, VESTING IN THEM ALL NECESSARY POWERS TO EXECUTE ALL DOCUMENTS, CONTRACTS, LEASES, AND APPLICATIONS ON BEHALF OF THE COMPANY, AND TO MANAGE THE DAY-TO-DAY OPERATIONS, WITH RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF MINUTE BOOKS, REGISTERS OF SHAREHOLDERS, AND COMPLIANCE WITH THE LAWS OF TAIWAN AND THE UNITED STATES WITH RESPECT TO E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS. FIFTH, THAT THE BOARD HEREBY ADOPTS A CORPORATE SEAL AND AUTHORIZES THE CORPORATE SECRETARY TO AFFIX THE SAME UNTO ALL SHARES, CONTRACTS, AND OTHER INSTRUMENTS AS REQUIRED BY LAW; AND SIXTH, THAT THE BOARD FURTHER RESOLVES BY UNANIMOUS CONSENT TO RATIFY ALL ACTS DONE PRIOR TO THIS MEETING BY THE PROMOTERS AND AGENTS OF THE COMPANY, AND TO DIRECT THE OFFICERS TO CAUSE ALL REQUIRED GOVERNMENT FILINGS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE COMPANY REGISTRATION, THE FOREIGN INVESTMENT FILING, THE TAX REGISTRATION, AND THE LABOR INSURANCE AND HEALTH INSURANCE REGISTRATIONS, TO BE MADE WITH THE APPROPRIATE AUTHORITIES WITH THE REASONABLE DELIBERATION REQUIRED TO EFFECTUATE THE INCORPORATION WITHOUT DELAY. THIS RESOLUTION IS EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY AND UPON THE EXPIRATION OF ANY STATUTORY REVIEW PERIOD SHALL BE DEEMED FINAL, BINDING, AND BINDING UPON ALL SHAREHOLDERS, DIRECTORS, AND OFFICERS OF THE COMPANY.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Business Scope Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, through its Investment Online Application System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor (China-based entity) must submit an application for foreign investment approval to the Investment Commission. The applicant must file the completed application form in English or Chinese, attaching a notarized certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent, a bank reference letter proving financial standing, audited financial statements for the past year, a detailed proposed business scope describing the production and overseas sale of hard enamel lapel pins, and a short-term capital deployment plan. The Investment Commission will review the proposed investment for compliance with negative lists, national security screenings, and permitted industries. Approval must be obtained prior to remitting the capital injection into Taiwan. If the Commission raises questions, the applicant must provide supplementary explanations within fifteen days; failure to do so will cause the application to be suspended. The remedy is to file a written response with additional documentary evidence, and an internal appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs if the rejection is not cured.
required_dossiers: Application for Foreign Investment Approval
Certificate of Incorporation of foreign parent company
Audited financial statements or bank statement of the investing entity
Business scope proposal containing ISIC 3240 hard enamel lapel pin manufacturing
Articles of Incorporation of the Taiwanese entity to be formed
Power of attorney appointing a local agent or law firm
Board resolution authorizing the investment and capital commitment
Personal identification or passport copies of proposed directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, submit a supplementary information letter within 15 calendar days; if suspended for incomplete documents, respond with all missing notarized translations; if rejected, appeal to the Executive Yuan for administrative reconsideration within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Company Name Reservation System and local notarial authority (District Court or licensed notary public in Taipei)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the foreign investment approval, the founders must reserve the proposed English and Chinese company names with the MOEA online name reservation system. The name must be unique and not confusingly similar to existing registered names; the reservation is valid for six months and can be renewed once. The founders shall then execute the Articles of Incorporation, including the registered office address, share structure, directors' appointment under Article 192, the purpose of manufacturing and global sales of enamel lapel pins, and the capital amount. The Articles of Incorporation must be notarized to authenticating a private document in accordance with the Notary Act, and each founder's signature must be witnessed by the notary. If the notary queries the legality of the business purpose or the validity of the representative's authority, the applicant must obtain a corrected corporate parent board resolution and re-notarization before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft Articles of Incorporation in Chinese and English
Parent company board resolution approving the Articles of Incorporation
Notarized passport or foreign corporation certificate of directors
Foreign investment approval certificate
Lease or proof of registered office right to use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected, choose a variation with additional distinctive English alphabetical terms (e.g., 'Taiwan Hard Enamel Lapel Pin Co., Ltd.') and resubmit; if notarization is suspended, provide a notarized apostilled copy of the parent company certificate and a legalized translation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Escrow, Capital Verification, and Issuance of Equity Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan banks authorized to open foreign account for capital, and a Taiwan certified public accountant registered with the MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign parent must remit the subscribed capital to a newly opened escrow share deposit account in the name of the future company or with the appointing bank, clearly stating the purpose 'capital for incorporation.' Once deposited, the funds shall not be withdrawn except for approved preparatory expenditures such as rent, attorney fees, and registration fees, and then only after written board approval and with the accountant's knowledge. The company engages a licensed CPA to issue a capital verification report confirming the amount of paid-up capital exists and is actually credited in NTD. After the company is duly registered and the business is established, the board issues registered share certificates to the shareholder or shareholders, recording all amounts paid and the number of shares, and cancels the escrow restriction or transfers the funds into the general operating account. If the capital is not fully remitted within the statutory period, the board must either return the funds under the escrow order or file a revised capital amendment.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment approval certificate
Bank remittance instructions and currency exchange receipt
Bank confirmation of escrow capital account
CPA engagement letter
Draft capital verification report template
Potential interim balance sheet
Lease agreement and professional fees invoices
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank refuses to accept remittance due to money laundering concerns, apply for a special beneficial ownership declaration and obtain an enhanced compliance statement from the Taiwanese bank; if CPA declines to sign, ensure all capital is authorized through the central foreign exchange system and present a bank certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Filing with the Registry and Issuance of the Business Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Company and Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Online Portal (or local regional office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company or its attorney must complete the online incorporation filing to the central registry, uploading all documents, including the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the CPA capital verification report, a name reservation certificate, foreign investment approval, proof of registered office address, and the list of directors and their consents. Standard procedure requires filing within 15 days after the end of the matching period. The registry will check the legality of the company name, address, minimum paid-in capital no longer mandatory, statutory directors' qualifications, and the corporate purpose. Upon approval, the registry issues the Business Registration Certificate and the unified business tax registration (Business Administration Number). This certificate serves as the company's definitive formation document. The company must then display the certificate on the premises and transmit copy to the local tax authority within one month for value-added tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Copy of Foreign Investment Approval
CPA capital verification report
Name reservation certificate
Consent letters of the initial directors and supervisor
Registered office proof (building permit, lease, or board resolution on address)
Identity or passport of the legal representative
Foreign exchange remittance receipt
Application form of incorporation registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query or suspension, respond within 15 days by supplying the electronic missing information; if the application lapses, restart by paying a nominal file reopening fee; if the denial is disputed, raise an administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor, Social Insurance, and Business Licensing Post-Incorporation Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taipei National Tax Administration (KAN&YEN) and Local Labor Insurer and Health Insurance Administration, plus local municipal government for factory and precinct permits
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the company certificate is issued, the company must carry out post-formation registrations: (a) apply for a unified invoice and enter the VAT (Business Tax Act) system using the Business Administration Number; (b) register with the Ministry of Labor for Labor Insurance and Pension and with the Health Insurance Administration for National Health Insurance; (c) apply to the local fire department for the fire safety inspection certificate if the manufacturing premises store flammable materials; (d) if the manufacturing site occupies an industrial or commercial building, submit an application for a factory registration to the municipal government or central authority once production begins. For physical manufacturing under ISIC 3240 hard enamel lapel pins, all operating registrations must be in place before machines are put into commercial production. Should any authority block the operation, the company may request an internal review, or, in cases involving regulatory technical standards, submit an amended facility layout and hire an EHS consultant.
required_dossiers: Business Registration Certificate
Articles of Incorporation and Company Seal
Lease or ownership title of registered office and factory
Photographs of the factory floor and ventilation systems
Environmental registration or self-assessment
Civil Defense/ Fire Inspection Application and taxi plan
Name and ID of the workplace safety chief
Employee listing and contract work for labor insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration fails, respond to the National Tax Administration's missing document list; if labor insurance registration is queried, provide employment details correction sheet; if fire inspection fails, rectify the deficiencies and request a re-inspection within 20 days, paying any minor civil penalties only if liability attaches.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Bureau, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA-IDB) and Taipei City/County Civil Administration and Fire Bureau, depending on the registered factory location
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證明) under the Factory Management Act, supplemented by the Municipal Class B Manufacturing and Packaging Operation Permit and the Business Operation License issued by the local government

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Executive Yuan, through its Bureau of Environmental Protection or the local Environmental Impact Assessment Committee
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Category C) - Limited EIA Review due to light enamel coating and surface finishing, with a mandatory self-monitoring waste management plan and, depending on annual throughput, the absence of hazardous chemical reaction exempting a full EIA report; if the factory utilizes > 20 tonnes of enamel pigments containing heavy metals per year, upgrade to a Class II Environmental Impact Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: treated process water and cooling water discharge must conform to Taiwan EPA Effluent Standards, including pH 6.0-9.0, COD ≤ 100 mg/L, BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, SS ≤ 30 mg/L, oil ≤ 5 mg/L, Pb ≤ 1 mg/L, and Cr(VI) ≤ 0.5 mg/L. Air emissions: total volatile organic compounds (TVOC) from enameling ovens shall be ≤ 0.6 kg/hr or ≤ 10 tonnes per year, otherwise an Air Pollution Control Permit is needed; particulate matter from polishing ≤ 100 mg/m3; acid and alkaline exhaust shall be scrubbed to comply with Taiwan Clean Air Act Standards. Hazardous waste: all waste acid, enamel sludge, and polishing filter residue must be manifested, stored in impermeable bins, and delivered to an approved disposal contractor within 90 days; no onsite open burning or burial is permitted.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification: a fire inspection and Safety and Means of Egress Certificate (消防安全檢修申報) issued by the Taiwan Fire Board, required for the factory's production, paint booth, and raw material storage area; the factory must maintain a fire extinguisher system, manual fire alarms, emergency exits, and flammable material store signage. Structural load inspection: a licensed civil/structural engineer must verify that the floor load supports the enamel kiln and finishing machines; workers' occupational health clearance issued by the labor inspection authority of the Ministry of Labor, conforming to the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including noise exposure below 85 dBA, air naphtha or WHER residual solvent within the permissible exposure limits (methanol 50 ppm, isopropanol 400 ppm), installing grinders with dust collectors, and completing an annual workplace risk assessment and first aid training program.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance (Taiwan) and its regional National Taxation Bureaus; electronic filing and integration services reside at the 'My Tax' portal (https://www.tax.nat.gov.tw) and the e-Invoice Platform (https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw) for rapid registration filing, VAT reporting, and export document reconciliation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident investor establishing a WFOE (limited liability) in Taiwan must first obtain approval from the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) under the Foreign Investment Act. After approval, the investor submits the company incorporation application to the MOEA Department of Company Registration, together with the articles of incorporation, the foreign exchange remittance proof of paid-in capital, and the investment approval letter. Upon incorporation, the MOEA automatically issues the ten-digit Unified Business Number (UBN / TIN), which is the single tax identification number for corporate income tax, VAT, customs, and export purposes. Immediately before starting commercial operations, the WFOE must file for business (VAT) registration with the local Revenue Service Office of the National Taxation Bureau in its jurisdiction under Article 6 of the Business Tax Act, using the UBN and supplying business premises, inventory, and accounting system details. The non-resident parent company without a Taiwanese permanent establishment does not require a separate TIN unless it derives Taiwan-sourced income requiring withholding or wishes to claim a tax treaty benefit, in which case it may request a Non-Resident Tax Certificate from the local National Taxation Bureau. A foreign expatriate manager involved in daily operations needs to register for an Alien Tax Identification Number through the National Immigration Agency and the local National Taxation Bureau.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections for WFOE limited companies; the WFOE is unconditionally a resident corporate entity taxable at entity level under the Income Tax Act, and no pass-through or fiscally transparent election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the Business Tax Act (Article 7 et seq.)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: TWD 80,000 average monthly taxable sales of goods (TWD 40,000 for services); when a business is engaged in export sales, VAT registration and zero-rating entitlement are mandatory regardless of the sales volume threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates the issuance of Uniform Invoices by all VAT-registered businesses. Under the current New Generation E-Invoicing regime, each VAT-registered business must obtain an official digital certificate and integrate with the Ministry of Finance e-Invoice Platform through an accredited Turnkey/API channel. Invoice data (including the export-specific zero-rated invoice) must be transmitted to the Platform in the prescribed XML format within the statutory filing cycle, and the Platform performs automatic data matching with customs export declarations, logisistics manifests, and foreign exchange remittance records. There is no separate anti-fraud fiscal stamping hardware, but the National Taxation Bureau enforces inter-system real-time cross-checks and issues audit alarms on discrepancies between e-invoice amounts, customs declarations, and bank inward remittances.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Taiwan to a foreign destination qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act. The sale must be made to a foreign buyer, the goods must physically leave Taiwan customs territory, and the Taiwan seller must be the customs declarant or be expressly identified on the export export declaration. For enamel pins merchandising made in Taiwan and sold through Etsy/Direct Pay or Stripe to international consumers, the goods-export route applies: the seller must generate a commercial invoice for export, file a customs export declaration at the port of departure, and retain documentary proof of actual shipment. Qualifying offshore digital services are not part of this physical-product transaction and would require additional evidence of consumption abroad if used; for physical enamel pins, the zero-rating is substantiated solely by customs-verified export and FX collection.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Declaration form issued by the Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance, with the barcoded of entry release number)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from a Taiwanese port to a foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (Foreign Exchange Settlement Certificate) issued by a licensed bank confirming receipt of the sales proceeds from the overseas buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau cross-validates every zero-rated export invoice against the Customs Administration's export declaration database and the foreign exchange bank's inward remittance records. If the required customs or FX documents are missing, incomplete, or contradict the e-invoice data, the tax authority will retroactively assess VAT at 5% from the date of the underlying sale, impose daily interest under the Tax Collection Act, and apply a statutory penalty of up to five times the evaded tax under the Tax Evasion and Irregularity Penalty Act. Where forged customs declarations, false shipping documents, or collusive bank certificates are detected, criminal liability under the Customs Act and the Criminal Code applies, all previously claimed export VAT refunds are clawed back with compound interest, and the exporter's zero-rating authorization is revoked prospectively.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC), acting through the local SAFE branch where the China WFOE is registered.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with current-account convertibility on a genuine-transaction basis and strict capital-account controls. The Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise may convert USD, EUR, and RMB through licensed domestic banks for trade-related receipts and payments, but every conversion must be supported by authentic commercial documentation entered into SAFE's trade monitoring system. Capital-account inflows, including equity injections from the Taiwan shareholder, require FDI foreign exchange registration before remittance, and the received foreign capital must be used for the registered business purposes only. Dividends and profits may be repatriated to Taiwan after the WFOE completes annual statutory audits, files and pays corporate income tax, and presents the banks with profit distribution resolutions and tax clearance proofs, while the banks perform current-account verification. The RMB is not freely convertible outside mainland for capital positions, and the Taiwan parent should use USD or other freely convertible currency for capital injections and NDF-style hedging arrangements outside China when necessary. Surplus capital in WFOE settlement accounts cannot be used for offshore securities, speculative real estate, entrusted loans, or unauthorized intercompany lending, and any restricted use must be handled through a separate compliance procedure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the SAFE trade foreign-exchange administration framework, export proceeds of hard enamel lapel pins and other merchandise must be repatriated to a foreign-exchange settlement account or RMB settlement account at a licensed domestic bank within 180 days from shipment or within the payment terms of the underlying sales contract, commercial invoice, letter of credit, or documentary collection instruction; overdue receivables beyond the agreed trade period must be reported to the bank. There is currently no mandatory fixed ratio requiring conversion of export foreign currency into RMB; the WFOE may choose to settle into RMB or retain the foreign currency within its approved current-account balance, provided the bank validates the transaction using the trade verification code. The retention period for unrealized export receivables is monitored against export customs declarations and logistics documents, and if the proceeds are retained abroad for a valid commercial reason, a SAFE filing must be made; no unauthorized surrender or delayed repatriation is permitted.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Account for FDI Equity Injection plus RMB/USD Operational Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Settlement Account with Foreign Exchange Trade Settlement Facility
Business Foreign Exchange Current Account with RMB Clearing Account
Working Capital RMB Account with Foreign Exchange Receivables Settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital banks and electronic money institutions are not legally authorized to open corporate treasury accounts or perform RMB clearing for a mainland China WFOE; therefore their feasibility as the WFOE's primary banking venue is LOW to NIL. Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe can function only as payment aggregators for collecting overseas retail receipts; the underlying settlement must ultimately be remitted by licensed acquiring/payment institutions into a bank account held by the WFOE at a SAFE-regulated Chinese bank. The WFOE must keep the platform settlement reports, transaction-level CSV files, refunds, and chargeback data to support trade authenticity; otherwise the bank may freeze the incoming remittance. Any arrangement using a foreign EMI to maintain liquidity offshore or pre-fund overseas disbursements on behalf of the WFOE would breach SAFE retention rules and should be rejected by the compliance committee.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative, the Taiwan beneficial shareholder if natural, and the finance/treasury controller must appear physically at a branch of the selected tier-1 bank for an in-person KYC interview before the account is activated. Remote consular opening is not accepted as a routine procedure by mainland Chinese banks for newly incorporated foreign-invested entities; POA-based alternate signatory opening is possible only after the core identity and ownership chain have been physically verified. The WFOE must provide its original business license, articles of association, tenancy lease in the entity's name, company seal registration, board resolutions, and tax registration certificate during the visit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership of the Taiwan shareholder and any cross-strait political/economic exposure along the ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Taiwan corporate registry extract showing all 25% or greater natural persons; valid Taiwan ID/passports of those UBOs; Taiwan Investment Commission approval letter for the outbound mainland investment; certificate of incorporation and audited financial statements of the Taiwan parent for the last two years; bank reference letter from the Taiwan parent's principal banker; signed UBO declaration and org chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Verification that the capital injection is genuine FDI and not disguised round-tripping, unofficial cross-border lending, or ownership transfer evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FDI foreign exchange registration form issued by SAFE through the receiving bank; board resolution and shareholder meeting minutes approving the registered capital amount and subscription schedule; source-of-funds evidence comprising twelve months of Taiwan bank statements, corporate tax filings, and dividend/asset sale documents; notarized share subscription agreement and capital contribution schedule; legal opinion letter from a PRC law firm confirming the investment structure complies with the Foreign Investment Law and the Cross-Strait Investment Protection Agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Physical substance of the WFOE in the die-struck brass cloisonné and enamel pins manufacturing/e-commerce business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial lease for the processing or office site; utility bills in the WFOE name; machinery lease and production equipment purchase contracts; employee social insurance and payroll records; supplier contracts for brass sheet, enamel, plating, molds; product sample catalogue or quality inspection certificates for ISIC 3240 enamel lapel pins; site photographs and, if possible, invitation for a bank compliance site visit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The payment rails through Etsy and Stripe create aggregated retail settlement flows with refunds, chargebacks, and possible third-country wires.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed platform seller agreements; monthly Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe settlement reports with transaction details; standard sales terms and refund policy; customer invoices and shipping/customs documentation; chargeback and dispute resolution logs; evidence that the WFOE is the registered payee in the settlement system; clear reconciliation from platform payout currency to the receiving domestic foreign-exchange account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan parent must first obtain approval for mainland investment and then complete the FDI Foreign Exchange Registration with the local SAFE / delegated bank using the WFOE's business license and the investment approval document. After registration, the bank opens an FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account; the Taiwan parent wires USD or another freely convertible currency by SWIFT MT103 with the SAFE capital account purpose code for foreign-invested enterprise equity capital contribution or capital increase. The bank credits the capital account and applies the proceeds under the FDI registration scope; the WFOE can then settle into RMB for operating expenses. A Chinese certified public accountant prepares the capital verification report and the Receipt and Payment Confirmation for FDI Foreign Exchange Capital is filed; the legal representative's identity, UBO dossier, and source of funds are re-verified at each drawdown.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For procurement of raw materials, molds, and packaging materials, the WFOE uses SWIFT MT103 for direct payments to suppliers when payment terms are open account; Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700/MT707) are used for high-value mould-making or large batch orders with trusted overseas suppliers; and Documentary Collections at sight or term are used for lower-risk intermediate deliveries. All outbound payments must be matched by import customs declarations, purchase contracts, and warehouse inbound records, and banks apply the domestic trade verification code to meet SAFE's anti-money-laundering and trade-finance reconciliation requirements. For retail sales, Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe remit gross proceeds through licensed payment gateways to the WFOE's designated bank account, and the bank verifies the platform settlement as export current-account receipts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore plain-vanilla RMB/USD forward contracts for genuine trade receivables and trade payables, with maturity based on the underlying sales/procurement contract and within the bank's credit line.
Onshore cross-currency swaps (RMB/USD or RMB/EUR) that strictly match the timing and amount of domestic operating cash flows and inbound FDI settlement, approved by the bank as real-demand hedging.
Fee-based exchange rate options for current account hedging, subject to SAFE real-demand verification and bank suitability assessment.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) involving the China WFOE as a direct counterparty are not permissible in the onshore market; the Taiwan parent may hedge RMB portfolio exposure outside mainland with NDFs only to the extent permitted by Taiwan regulations, but such instruments must not be booked in the WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders meeting approval of financial statements, business report, and profit-distribution or loss-offsetting proposal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders; post-meeting corporate particulars delivered to the Ministry of Economic Affairs Commercial Registration Office and the company registry database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than six months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, the meeting and final-accounts approval must be completed by 30 June. Post-meeting registration particulars, when required, are filed within 15 days after the meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors who fail to convene or complete the statutory annual meeting without lawful cause may be fined NT$10,000 to NT$50,000 by the competent authority. Continuous failure to hold the meeting or prolonged business suspension beyond statutory tolerance can trigger administrative strike-off by dissolution order under the Taiwan Company Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking enterprise income tax settlement return with annual financial statements and tax reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, having jurisdiction over the registered office in Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 May through 31 May following the calendar year; a one-month professional extension to 30 June is available where prior approval and accountant-prepared records are in place. Non-calendar fiscal years follow the equivalent statutory anniversary window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the company to official estimated assessment, a penalty of not less than 3 percent and up to three times the understated tax, and a late-payment surcharge of 1 percent for each two-day period of delay up to 15 percent. Repeated non-filing can lead to cancellation of tax registration and subsequent administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual foreign-investor operations and business-performance report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following each reporting calendar year, or on the anniversary date stated in the foreign-investment approval certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or submission of materially false operational data can result in fines, suspension or revocation of the foreign-investment approval, withdrawal of tax preferences if any, and administrative order requiring capital repatriation or liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership register update and AML-confirmation filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs company registration system and Taiwan Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering Control Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any qualifying shareholding, voting-right, or beneficial-ownership change; if there has been no change, the board must reconfirm the register at the annual ordinary shareholders meeting each calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is an AML administrative offence carrying fines from NT$50,000 to NT$1,000,000 per occurrence. False entries may also attract personal criminal liability for directors or the responsible company secretary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory register audit and physical maintenance of corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of directors and company secretary; register books must be available for inspection at the registered office by shareholders, officers, and authorized authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year, and again immediately before the annual shareholders meeting; every share transfer, director change, charge, and corporate resolution must be posted to the registers without undue delay.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incomplete or false statutory registers undermine the evidentiary validity of corporate actions and can subject the responsible director to statutory fines. Serious register irregularities, particularly those facilitating concealment of ownership, can trigger investigation, registration cancellation, and strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Taiwan Company Act, Commercial Accounting Act, and Ministry of Economic Affairs implementing rules, a licensed independent CPA audit is mandatory where: (a) the company is a public company, bank, insurance company, securities firm, or financial holding company; (b) the company's paid-in capital is NT$30 million or more; (c) the company's balance-sheet total assets are NT$300 million or more; (d) the preceding-year annual turnover or revenue is NT$100 million or more; (e) the company has an average headcount of 100 or more employees during the fiscal year; or (f) the National Taxation Bureau requires the income-tax return to be accompanied by a CPA-attested financial report because of scale or audit-selection criteria. The audit must be performed by a certified public accountant licensed in Taiwan and appointed at the annual shareholders meeting.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Mandatory statutory financial statements for a non-public WFOE in Taiwan are prepared under the Commercial Accounting Act and Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards for SMEs. If the WFOE is part of an IFRS-consolidated group, the statutory individual statements follow Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission, with tax-basis accounts reconciled to the Income Tax Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan operates an event-driven and annual-confirmation hybrid regime. The WFOE must keep a current beneficial-ownership register at its registered office and report any qualifying shareholding or beneficial-ownership change to the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the Taiwan Financial Intelligence Unit within 30 days of the transfer or change. At the annual shareholders meeting, the board must reconfirm the UBO schedule, reconcile it against the share register, transfer instruments, and shareholder approvals, and retain a signed record of the confirmation. Discrepancies identified during a register audit must be remedied within the 30-day reporting window to avoid AML penalties.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 to USD 2,200 per year depending on Taipei registered-office address, company-secretary services, mail handling, and annual minutes-book preparation.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 to USD 10,000 per year for a low-risk enamel-pins manufacturer with a statutory audit obligation; smaller exempt operations may pay USD 1,500 to USD 3,500 for review-level annual accounts.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Enterprise Income Tax (CIT) rate under Article 4 of the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday; qualified Small Low-Profit Enterprises may pay tax on reduced taxable income at the 20% preferential rate, producing an effective 5% rate on annual taxable income up to CNY 3 million under the current 2023-2027 SME relief; 15% rate for High and New Technology Enterprises and for enterprises in certain encouraged free-trade zones or Western Regions; 100% super deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; default CIT loss carryforward is 5 years, extended to 10 years for eligible high-tech and technology-advanced small-and-medium enterprises

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Class A, Form A100000) with supporting schedules (including A000000 basic information and related-party transaction schedules), filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration e-Tax Bureau (China Electronic Tax Administration); quarterly provisional returns are filed on Form A200000
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual reconciliation return with quarterly provisional CIT prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly CIT prepayment within 15 days after each quarter-end; annual reconciliation return and final payment due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end (generally May 31 of the following year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue from the manufacture and sale of die-struck brass cloisonne hard enamel lapel pins, including export sales and e-commerce platform sales (Etsy, Stripe), stated on a value-added-tax-exclusive basis in RMB
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all China-source sales revenue; do not defer revenue through an offshore Taiwan intermediary without substantive functions; use arm's length prices if selling to a related Taiwan distributor; retranslate foreign-currency Etsy and Stripe settlements at the appropriate monthly or annual average exchange rate and retain payout statements and platform fee invoices

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost: direct production expenditures such as brass discs, enamel paints, die-struck mold depreciation, electroplating, polishing, plating chemicals, factory labor, quality control and production-related packaging
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If raw materials or semi-finished brass pins are purchased from the Taiwan parent or a related supplier, the cost must be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation using CUP, Cost Plus or TNMM benchmarking; customs valuations and VAT invoices must align with the CIT cost basis

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges: urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, property tax, land use tax, stamp duty and other turnover-related taxes other than CIT and VAT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only legally accrued surcharges; compute from actual VAT paid and export rebates; no deduction is allowed for CIT itself or for penalties, fines and late-payment surcharges; over-accrual to reduce income is a transfer pricing risk

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses: Etsy marketplace commissions, Stripe payment processing fees, advertising, trade shows, overseas shipping, freight, e-commerce warehousing and after-sales warranty costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Substantiate platform fee deductions with monthly merchant statements; if the Taiwan parent provides marketing, branding or channel services, retain written service agreements, evidence of actual personnel and expenses, and invoice withholding; otherwise the fee may be recharacterized as non-deductible profit distribution

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses: management salaries, rent, utilities, professional fees, legal and accounting fees, import-export compliance costs, general office expenses and qualifying R&D expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party management fees from Taiwan are deductible only if real and necessary services were rendered with economic substance; no intra-group service charges based solely on allocation keys without benefit received; consider whether a Taiwan service provider creates a permanent establishment in China; keep labor and time records and benchmark fees

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses: interest on loans, bank service charges, guarantee fees and foreign exchange losses attributable to financing activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to the Taiwan shareholder is subject to China thin-capitalization rules applying a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for non-financial enterprises; excess interest is non-deductible; WFOE must withhold 10% EIT on interest (or 7% if the Cross-Strait Agreement relief is properly claimed) and document the arm's length rate, loan agreement, and actual fund flow

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit and total profit before tax, after adding non-operating income and subtracting non-operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Profit must reflect the economic functions, assets and risks actually borne by the WFOE; if key management, design, IP ownership and pricing decisions are made in Taiwan without corresponding remuneration, the China tax authority may reallocate profit to the WFOE

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax reconciliation adjustments: increases for non-deductible expenses, transfer pricing adjustments, thin-capitalization interest disallowance, entertainment and advertising caps, and decreases for R&D super deduction, tax-exempt income, and other qualified deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual CIT return requires reconciliation between accounting profit and taxable income; cross-border intercompany transactions must be adjusted to the arm's length standard; failure to prepare or submit contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation may lead to deemed adjustments and penalties

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after offsetting prior-year losses within the statutory carryforward period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WFOE losses may offset profits only within the 5-year default period (10 years for qualified innovative SMEs); no group loss relief is available with a Taiwan parent; loss carryforward schedules must be retained and traceable to audited financial statements

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable computed at 25% before preferential reductions, foreign tax credits and quarterly prepayment credits; final balancing tax due or refundable amount
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the correct preferential rate with statutory qualification certificates; when remitting dividends to the Taiwan shareholder, the WFOE is the withholding agent and must withhold 10% EIT on the distribution; the 5% reduced rate under the Cross-Strait Agreement is available only with a Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate, proven beneficial ownership, and at least 25% direct shareholding

stage_6.failure_penalties: Failure to file or late filing attracts penalties under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law of up to CNY 2,000, or CNY 2,000 to CNY 10,000 for serious cases, plus a 0.05% per-day late-payment surcharge on unpaid tax under Article 32; understated or evaded tax triggered by false returns triggers Article 63 penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax; criminal thresholds under Article 201 of the PRC Criminal Law apply where the amount of evaded tax is relatively large and exceeds 10% of the taxable amount, with fines, confiscation and imprisonment up to 3 years, or up to 7 years under aggravated circumstances; serious tax offenders are publicly blacklisted with travel and exit restrictions imposed on the legal representative and directors
